newsitem.title: USA: Apartment Invest prices stock at $23.428.
newsitem.headline: Apartment Invest prices stock at $23.428.

text.p: Apartment Investment and Management Co said on Friday it had priced its public offering of 1.1 milion shares of Class A common stock at $23.428 per share, to raise $25.8 million.
Proceeds will be used to repay a portion of acquisition-related debt, the company said.
Upon completion of the offering, Apartment Investment said it would have 17.4 million shares and units outstanding.
The common stock offering is being underwritten by Raymond James & Associates Inc, Apartment Investment said.
The underwriter has an over-allotment option on 165,000 additional shares at $23.428 each.
